TEXT:
Time passed, it is the day of our next date. Once 
again, I've arrived at Kuroneko's home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well then.

Just when I was about to press the intercom 
button...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Ah, Kousaka-kun. Welcome!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Welcome!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, going out?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
I wanted to watch over you two but... Ruri-nee is 
holding some dishes for dinner hostage.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well that's unfortunate.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
So, I wont be able to help you out, but hang in 
there!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: I'm hoping for the success of your ritual, Onii-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Gotcha.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Welcome, K...Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm coming in.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I-I'll make some tea.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Okay.
...Isn't Kuroneko acting a bit strange?

Wait, oh yeah. We're alone in this house now, just 
the two of us... It suddenly feels embarrassing being 
here, now that I noticed it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Sorry for the wait.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ah, thanks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Y-You're not saying anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hmm, ah... Oh yeah, it's just you and me here today, 
huh.
...What am I even saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
W-What about it? It's not like there's anything 
different about this, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-That's true.

W-What should I do about this situation? It just got 
tense all of a sudden...

Oh yeah, the other day, Hinata mentioned it. The 
importance of setting the mood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, isn't this a great chance?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: C-Chance? What in the world are you thinking...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: N-No! I-It's not what it sounds like!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Pervert.

Kuroneko is looking downward and avoiding eye 
contact. She's completely gotten the wrong idea, no 
way we can get closer right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Calm down. I'm not going to do anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You don't have to be so nervous.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Fu-fufufufufu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Kuroneko?
Did I turn on a weird switch of hers...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You don't have the guts, do you, Kyousuke?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmph. You can say whatever you like.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Goodness, my boyfriend is acting like a child. Even 
though we're finally alone today...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're one to talk...
Still, we're not making any progress at this rate...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: W-What is it?
Could this get any more awkward...?!

Would be nice if there's a good conversation topic, 
maybe something to do, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Simply put! It's the 3-point advice set that will help 
you court Ruri-nee!!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: With this, you'll easily grab ahold of Ruri-nee's heart!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: N-No! It's nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Really?

I looked inside the small bag that Hinata gave me 
at a position where Kuroneko can't see it.

The bag contained 3 folded pieces of memos and a 
small box. I took out the piece of memo with a 1 
written on it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Let's see...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Ruri-nee's Napolitan Spaghetti is 
[font_size=33]totally[/font_size] delicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
I sang my praises about it before, so just ask her 
and she'll surely make it for you. By the way, the 
ingredients are in the fridge.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...So, what's my next move?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Are you okay? You have been looking down for 
some time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ah, well about that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I actually haven't had lunch before I got here! I'm 
feeling kinda hungry!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If that's the case, shall I make something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Let's see... I'm in the mood for some Napolitan 
Spaghetti right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I-Is that so? I wonder if I have the ingredients... Wait 
right here.

Kuroneko said as she got up, heading into the 
kitchen. After a while, I heard some humming and a 
knife cutting something.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...Seems like I can actually trust the advice Hinata 
gave me.
Okay, let's take the chance to read another memo.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Our family photo album's hidden below the TV. 
There's a ton of rare photos of Ruri-nee inside!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: An album, huh...

Sure enough, there's something below the TV 
matching that description. But is it okay for me to 
look without asking?

Despite that, I started flipping through the pages of 
the album against my better judgment.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-This is...!

[font_size=30]O[/font_size][font_size=28]o[/font_size][font_size=25]h[/font_size][font_size=23]h[/font_size][font_size=22]h[/font_size], photos of Kuroneko as a child, 
so cute!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Okay, the food's read- wait, what are you doing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, well, it was just under the TV so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
That has to be Hinata. I keep telling her to put 
things back to where they were...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Look, there's even photos of you as a child.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah, d-don't just look at it as you please.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, sorry...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Oblivious of one's true nature and destiny, the 
recollections of a mortal child living foolishly... I can't 
bear to witness it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Err, basically what you're saying is... it's 
embarrassing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Y-Yes.

Thank goodness, I thought she was angry for a 
second there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But hey, you're dressed normally in these photos.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [font_size=18]Don't look at me in that... plain appearance.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You think so? I think it's cute though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I-Is that so... Oh, this brings back memories.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah...

We both stopped after our fingers touched while 
trying to turn the page.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: S-Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-It's fine...

Kuroneko's gazing up at me... my heart's throbbing 
like crazy. And from this angle, some of her 
cleavage...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah, this was from Hinata's Shichi-Go-San's festival...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah?

I came to my senses and averted my eyes from 
the defenseless Kuroneko, while reacting to the 
conversation.
